pricing_snapshot.source: GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models (unauthenticated), 2026-11-01: nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free returned HTTP 404 (no longer listed) on the first search-loop run and was replaced
pricing_snapshot.selection_rule: pricing.prompt == "0" && pricing.completion == "0" (and request/web_search absent or "0"), context_length >= 32000, text output, general instruct model; meta-routers (openrouter/free) excluded because they choose the model for us

excluded_models._rule: Dead or refused ids; never routed.

github_models_retired: GitHub Models was retired by GitHub on 2026-07-30; models.github.ai answers every request with HTTP 200 text/plain OK. Lane removed in v1.2.2.
gemini_models_probe: 2026-11-02 live probe with the real page prompt (no-billing key): gemini-2.5-flash-lite and 2.0-flash(-lite) answer HTTP 404 'no longer available to new users', so the lane had been gemini-2.5-flash alone and its small free daily quota, shared by every site through one key, was used up before the first runs of the day. 3.5-flash-lite 4.9s, 3.1-flash-lite 7.9s (reasoning_effort minimal; 'none' is HTTP 400 on 3.x lite), 3-flash-preview 12.5s (none). Each model has its own free daily quota, so four models = four quotas.
gemini_models_note: Gemini API free tier through GEMINI_API_KEY (a Google AI Studio key whose project has NO billing account, so it can never be charged; free-tier requests per model per day). Daily-quota 429 closes the lane for the run.

workers_ai._why: The account's free Workers AI allowance is 10,000 neurons/day and overage is billed. Studios hold 8,500 (creator-studios worker/lib/freeAi.ts, @cf/mistralai/mistral-small-3.1-24b-instruct). The engine uses a model nobody else uses (@cf/google/gemma-3-12b-it was withdrawn: 'This account is not allowed to access', 2026-11-01; now gemma-4-26b-a4b-it with thinking off so the output budget is the answer) so its own usage is measurable, reads today's usage from Cloudflare analytics before every call, stops at 600 neurons/day of its own and whenever the whole account is past 9,000, and fails closed if usage cannot be read. Rates (developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing, 2026-11-01): 9,091 / 27,273 neurons per M input / output tokens.
